topics.title: Meaning of accounting and the accounting process

concepts.learning_objective: State the meaning of accounting as defined by AICPA and AAA.
Distinguish external and internal economic events and identify the transactions an event comprises.
Explain identification, measurement, recording and communication as steps of the accounting process.

topics.title: Users of accounting information and their needs

concepts.learning_objective: Classify users of accounting information as internal or external users.
Identify the information each user group seeks from accounting reports.

topics.title: Accounting as a source of information and its branches

concepts.learning_objective: Explain why accounting is a source of information and a means of disseminating it to users.
Distinguish financial accounting, cost accounting and management accounting.
Explain reliability and relevance as qualities that make accounting information decision-useful.
Explain understandability and comparability and recognise when they are violated.
State the objectives of accounting, including ascertaining profit or loss and financial position.
Describe the different roles of accounting such as language of business and historical record.
Recognise that accounting information is historical, quantitative and financial in nature.

topics.title: Basic terms: entity, transaction, assets, liabilities and capital

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the business entity and decide whether an event is a transaction of that entity.
Classify assets and liabilities as current or non-current.
Explain capital and its treatment as a claim of the owner on the business.

topics.title: Basic terms: revenue, expenses, expenditure, profit, gain and loss

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish revenue, expense, revenue expenditure and capital expenditure.
Compute profit and distinguish it from gain and loss.

topics.title: Basic terms: discount, voucher, goods, drawings, purchases, stock, debtors and creditors

concepts.learning_objective: Explain trade discount, cash discount and vouchers.
Decide when an item is goods for a business and identify drawings by the owner.
Explain stock, debtors and creditors and their place in the balance sheet.
